bbs_together.config.cdn.title: Asset Sync
bbs_together.config.cdn.tooltip: BBS Together asset sync and CDN configuration
bbs_together.config.cdn.url-comment: CDN server address for asset synchronization.
bbs_together.config.cdn.token-comment: Token required to access the CDN server.
bbs_together.config.cdn.download-comment: When enabled, missing assets will be downloaded from the server.
bbs_together.config.cdn.upload-comment: When enabled, local assets will be uploaded to the server.
bbs_together.config.cdn.receive-comment: When enabled, the server tells you which assets another player just uploaded and you download only the files you are missing. Disabled means you learn about them on the next auto-sync or manual refresh.
bbs_together.config.cdn.progress_bar-com: Show a thin progress bar above the task bar while assets are syncing.
bbs_together.config.cdn.progress_bar_alw: Keep the progress bar visible after sync completes instead of fading it out.
bbs_together.config.server.title: Sync Settings
bbs_together.config.server.tooltip: Each player configures their own client-side download size ceiling.
bbs_together.config.server.auto_sync-com: When enabled, asset changes sync on their own: new or updated server assets are downloaded automatically (downloading must be on) and local asset changes are uploaded automatically (uploading must be on) — no need to press the download/upload buttons after every change.
bbs_together.config.server.auto_sync_coo: Minimum pause between automatic asset sync passes, 5 to 300 seconds. Raise this on busy servers to reduce manifest checks; default 20 seconds.
bbs_together.config.server.asset_send_in: Wait between slice batches when the server sends assets. Default 10 ms with 1024 KB batches means no artificial limit (the link is the limit). Raise it to slow one player down without affecting the others.
bbs_together.config.server.asset_send_ba: Slice size used when sending assets, 30 KB to 8 MB, default 1024 KB. Larger means more throughput and a larger single burst.
bbs_together.config.server.asset_upload_: Wait between slice batches while uploading local assets to the server. Default 10 ms with 4096 KB batches means no artificial limit (the link is the limit).
Size of one slice batch while uploading assets, 30 KB to 8 MB. Default 4096 KB. Larger means more throughput and a larger single burst.

Total upload speed limit for this client, default 0 = unlimited (fastest). Saturating your uplink is what queues the game's keepalives behind asset bytes and times the connection out; this limit is metered in bytes, so it is far more accurate than the batch interval. 0 disables the limit (fastest).
bbs_together.config.server.asset_egress_: Total speed limit for everything the server streams out of the assets folder. Default 0 = unlimited (fastest, uses the whole link). The send interval above is per player, so several clients pulling at once add up; if people start getting kicked again while downloading together, set this to 8192 or 4096 (KB/s) as a shared ceiling. Server side only: changing it on a client has no effect.
bbs_together.config.keyframes.tooltip: Default keyframe style for new keyframes created through BBS Together
bbs_together.config.keyframes.default_co: Color assigned to newly created keyframes when color override is enabled.
bbs_together.config.keyframes.title: Keyframes
bbs_together.config.keyframes.default_co: When enabled, newly created keyframes get the color below instead of using the track color.
bbs_together.config.keyframes.default_in: When enabled, newly created keyframes use the selected interpolation below. When disabled, BBSFS keeps its original track or previous-keyframe interpolation behavior.
bbs_together.config.keyframes.default_sh: Default shape for newly created keyframes. Click the icon on the right to choose a shape.
bbs_together.config.keyframes.default_in: When default keyframe interpolation is enabled, newly created keyframes use the interpolation selected here.

bbs_together.config.coop.title: Co-op recording
bbs_together.config.coop.tooltip: Invite players to record the same film together, each in their own replay
bbs_together.config.coop.coop_invite_sec: How long an invited player has to accept or decline before the invite is treated as declined. Default 60 s, range 10-600. Server side only: edit config/bbs/settings/bbs_together.json and restart on dedicated servers.
bbs_together.config.server.asset_sync_ma: Sync size ceiling (MB). This is the only size limit: files above it are neither downloaded nor uploaded, and the server does not advertise them to clients, so nobody pulls them in the background. Default 256 MB: models, textures and particles are usually a few MB, while a few hundred MB screen recording saturates the link on join and pushes the keepalive past the 30 second read timeout, which shows up as a connection reset. 0 = no ceiling, sync everything.
